visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white ink illustration depicting a landscape at night. On the left, two tall, tripod-like mechanical structures with domed tops stand in a dark, smoky area. On the right, a building is engulfed in flames and smoke. In the foreground, a group of small human figures stands observing the scene, while other figures and what appears to be a cannon are positioned near the burning structure.

suggestedMatch.exactSourceQuotation: The air was full of sound, a deafening and confusing conflict of noises⁠—the clangorous din of the Martians, the crash of falling houses, the thud of trees, fences, sheds flashing into flame, and the crackling and roaring of fire. Dense black smoke was leaping up to mingle with the steam from the river, and as the Heat-Ray went to and fro over Weybridge its impact was marked by flashes of incandescent white, that gave place at once to a smoky dance of lurid flames. The nearer houses still stood intact, awaiting their fate, shadowy, faint and pallid in the steam, with the fire behind them going to and fro.
